name: Taurasi
keyfacts: Taurasi is a red wine from the province of Avellino in Campania, made principally from Aglianico, and it became a DOCG in 1993.
Under DOCG rules Taurasi must be aged at least 3 years before release, with at least 1 year in wood, and Riserva at least 4 years.
Up to 15% of Barbera, Piedirosso and Sangiovese may be blended with the Aglianico.
The vineyards sit on volcanic soil, and Aglianico thrives at altitudes of around 1,300 to 1,600 feet above sea level.

blurb.text: A red wine from Avellino province in Campania, based principally on Aglianico, grown on volcanic soils. It became a DOC in 1970 and a DOCG in 1993. Its popularity is recent: until the early 1990s, one winery exported it.
